title: Football transfer rumours: Chelsea want Petr Cech back from Arsenal?
trail: Everton in for Welbeck, Richarlison and Malcom? | Gary Cahill to Manchester United? | Liverpool have Allison in the bag? | Newcastle want Rondon?
body: We all know the feeling of temptation to go back to something comforting. An old friend, that hoodie you’ve had since you were 16 which could thus tell your life story through stains, your bed instead of facing up to the grim realities of work and life. For Chelsea, that comforting thing is apparently Petr Cech. Now, we wouldn’t want to accuse them of lacking imagination, but if their solution to Thibaut Courtois’s apparently imminent departure to Real Madrid is to give the bloke whose spare boots are probably still at the training ground a ring, then … actually, that isn’t very imaginative, is it? The logical conclusion to this is of course Carlo Cudicini eventually replacing Cech, and Dmitri Kharine dusting off his jogging bottoms. Back in the land of the plausible, Kasper Schmeichel is another candidate to come in, but that’s more a bit underwhelming than silly, ergo less fun. A more impressive, bigger and frankly more handsome solution to their goalkeeping needs would be to bring in Brazilian stopper Allison. Liverpool look to have stolen a march on them there, a bid of around £62m wafting around Roma’s inbox, but Chelsea are not to be discouraged, and will hang around until the last. Sticking with Chelsea, their defence could be in for an overhaul following the arrival of Maurizio Sarri. Word is that Juventus defender Daniele Rugani is on his way in, which would mean Gary Cahill could be on his way out. Interestingly, Manchester United has been mooted as a potential destination, where he and Phil Jones can reminisce about watching England at the World Cup. Aleksandr Golovin has apparently been given the nod to move Stamford Bridge-wards by CSKA Moscow, and finally, Sarri has taken one look at Tiémoué Bakayoko and decided he’s not keen, and will punt him off to the nearest club with £40m. We know that signing players on the back of a good World Cup is a slightly foolish business, so good news Bournemouth fans: apparently the club is considering spending £57m on Colombia midfielder Jefferson Lerma and Uruguay’s corn-rowed Diego Laxalt. That’s £32m on the former and another £25m on the latter. Hopefully this isn’t just a result of Eddie Howe watching a few games on the telly then calling his chairman. Could be a busy time at Everton, who are supposedly sniffing around not only your actual Danny Welbeck, not only Watford flyer Richarlison, but Rumour Mill favourite Malcom too. Marco Silva apparently doesn’t think an attack which currently consists of Oumar Niasse and Cenk Tosun is quite up to snuff, which … well, it makes sense, doesn’t it? Odds and ends: Manchester City’s De Bruyne-a-like Oleksandr Zinchenko will probably be punted out on loan somewhere, with Wolves and Fulham keen; Newcastle want Salomón Rondón from West Brom but talks are slow, just one of the things irking Rafa Benítez about Toon life; Crystal Palace and Bournemouth want Brentford striker Ollie Watkins; Celtic aren’t budging on their £30m valuation of left-back Kieran Tierney. Fin.
